nodes.description: address public owner hardcoded to 0x00a107...6a64c71, used as access-control anchor and as recipient of transferAnyERC20Token.
Public drop(address,address[],uint256[]) that gates on msg.sender == owner and loops over recipients performing external transferFrom calls.
Public view helper returning true when addr is non-zero, not msg.sender and not a contract.
Internal view helper using inline assembly extcodesize to detect contracts.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
Public function that transfers an arbitrary ERC20 amount held by the contract to owner, with no access-control check.
External caller supplied via msg.sender; used both as access-control subject and as token source address.
External call token.transferFrom(msg.sender, recipients[i], amounts[i]) executed inside the drop loop.
External call ERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) inside transferAnyERC20Token.
Inline assembly extcodesize(addr) used to determine whether an address is a contract.
Arithmetic mutation available -= amounts[i] executed per loop iteration.
tokenAddress parameter of drop, cast to the ERC20 interface.
recipients array parameter of drop, iterated and validated.
amounts array parameter of drop, subtracted from available.
ERC20 token interface instance built from tokenAddress.
Balance of msg.sender read via token.balanceOf.
Allowance of msg.sender for this contract read via token.allowance.
available = min(balance, allowance), decremented in the loop.
Loop counter i for the recipients iteration.
addr parameter of isQualitifiedAddress.
result boolean returned by isQualitifiedAddress.
addr parameter of isContract.
size local populated by extcodesize assembly.
tokenAddress parameter of transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens amount parameter of transferAnyERC20Token.
External view calls token.balanceOf(msg.sender) and token.allowance(msg.sender, address(this)).

edges.reason: drop is gated by require(msg.sender == owner), so the untrusted caller controls entry into the function.
msg.sender is used as the from address of the external transferFrom call inside the loop.
drop performs an external token.transferFrom call per iteration before completing its own state accounting, enabling reentrant callbacks.
drop calls isQualitifiedAddress as a filter for each recipient.
isQualitifiedAddress delegates contract detection to isContract.
isContract reads extcodesize(addr) through inline assembly.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external ERC20 transfer call to an attacker-supplied token address.
owner is used as the destination of transferAnyERC20Token while the function itself has no caller restriction.
transferAnyERC20Token is public and callable by any msg.sender without an ownership check.
local available is decremented by amounts[i] in the arithmetic mutation.
amounts[i] is the subtrahend in available -= amounts[i].
available is only checked against amounts[i] before the transferFrom call.
tokenAddress parameter is cast into the ERC20 token interface local.
the token interface built from the untrusted tokenAddress is the receiver of the transferFrom external call.
each recipients[i] is passed to isQualitifiedAddress.
msg.sender is passed to token.balanceOf and token.allowance external view calls.
balance local receives the value returned by token.balanceOf.
allowance local receives the value returned by token.allowance.
available is computed from balance in the min(balance, allowance) expression.
available is computed from allowance in the min(balance, allowance) expression.
loop counter i drives the repeated arithmetic mutation of available.
tokenAddress parameter is cast into the ERC20 interface used for the external transfer call.
tokens parameter is the value passed to the external ERC20 transfer.
isContract addr parameter is fed into the extcodesize assembly operation.
extcodesize result is assigned to the size local.
size > 0 contributes to the result boolean of isQualitifiedAddress.
addr parameter determines result in isQualitifiedAddress.
